description: Defines the ReadableShippingSummary class, representing a summary of shipping information with getters and setters, including shipping options and related details.

classes.name: ReadableShippingSummary
classes.description: A serializable Java class that encapsulates shipping summary details, such as costs, options, and associated texts.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns the shipping cost as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getShippingModule
methods.description: Returns the name of the shipping module.

methods.name: isFreeShipping
methods.description: Indicates if the shipping is free.

methods.name: isTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Indicates if tax applies to shipping.

methods.name: setTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Sets whether tax applies to shipping.

methods.name: getShippingOptions
methods.description: Returns the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: setShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: getSelectedShippingOption
methods.description: Returns the currently selected shipping option.
